name: video-4-7-evidence-ledger-v1

lineage.reason: No official receipt, source commit, seed, or package hash accompanies the videos; the 4_7 filename component is treated only as a label.

facts: All three new videos visibly finish.
Track 1 is 0.32 seconds faster than the recorded submission-5 video while Track 2 is 0.26 seconds slower.
Track 3 changes from a submission-5 collision-limit DNF to a 30.58-second finish.
The top-down replay does not expose the policy's 4x84x84 observation, estimated speed, steering, gas, brake, collision telemetry, track seed, or package identity.
hypotheses: Additional low-speed clear-straight acceleration may reduce time spent recovering speed without moving the current braking boundary.
A globally faster vehicle or a more aggressive inside line is not established by these videos.

feedback_decision.vehicle_speed: partially accepted only as motivation for a bounded low-speed acceleration diagnostic; the videos do not establish low maximum speed
feedback_decision.inside_line: rejected for this change because the replay supplies no road-clearance/action telemetry, Track 2 regressed, and a fixed bias is not track-shape invariant

use_restrictions: All three videos are consumed development evidence and cannot confirm a candidate motivated by them.
Top-down coordinates, minimap geometry, progress, time, track identity, video filename, and obstacle order must not enter runtime policy logic or threshold fitting.
No performance, safety, submission, or SOTA claim follows from this ledger.
